errors.evidence: The description states there are five models, but the chart legend clearly shows four models: DNN-HMM, TDNN-HMM, LSTM-HMM, and End-to-End.

errors.text_span: 五个模型绘成的柱状图呈现在图表中的同一垂直轴上
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly describes the chart's structure. It is a grouped bar chart where for each of the five test sets on the horizontal axis, there is a group of four vertical bars, one for each model. The bars are not arranged 'on the same vertical axis'.
The color for the LSTM-HMM model is gray in the chart, not red.

errors.text_span: Test1的柱状图约为38%，Test2的柱状图约为36%，Test3的柱状图约为39%，Test4的柱状图约为36%和Test5的柱状图约为37%。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly provides a single value for each test set. Each test set (e.g., Test1) has four distinct bars, each with its own value. This sentence fails to describe the individual bars within each group.

errors.text_span: 柱状图中，DNN-HMM的柱状图最短，约为 38%，而TDNN-HMM 的柱状图最大，约为 40%。
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The DNN-HMM bars (blue) are consistently among the tallest in each group, not the shortest. The shortest bars are generally LSTM-HMM (gray) or End-to-End (yellow). The tallest bar overall is DNN-HMM in Test4 and Test5 (approx. 40%), not TDNN-HMM.

errors.text_span: 所有柱状图都呈现水平排列
errors.evidence: The bars in the chart are vertical columns, not arranged horizontally.

The description completely fails to mention the grouped structure of the bar chart, which is a critical feature. It does not explain that for each test set, there is a group of four bars corresponding to the four different models.
